name: heirloom-video
description: Remotion product film for Heirloom Life — isolated from main app deps

scripts.render:desktop: npx remotion render src/index.ts DesktopFilm --codec h264 --crf 18 --output out/desktop-master.mp4
scripts.render:desktop-web: npx remotion render src/index.ts DesktopFilm --codec h264 --crf 26 --output out/desktop-web.mp4
scripts.render:desktop-webm: npx remotion render src/index.ts DesktopFilm --codec vp8 --crf 10 --output out/desktop.webm
scripts.render:desktop-poster: npx remotion still src/index.ts DesktopFilm --frame 0 --output out/desktop-poster.jpg
scripts.render:mobile: npx remotion render src/index.ts MobileFilm --codec h264 --crf 18 --output out/mobile-master.mp4
scripts.render:mobile-web: npx remotion render src/index.ts MobileFilm --codec h264 --crf 26 --output out/mobile-web.mp4
scripts.render:mobile-webm: npx remotion render src/index.ts MobileFilm --codec vp8 --crf 10 --output out/mobile.webm
scripts.render:mobile-poster: npx remotion still src/index.ts MobileFilm --frame 0 --output out/mobile-poster.jpg
scripts.render:all: npm run render:desktop && npm run render:desktop-web && npm run render:desktop-webm && npm run render:desktop-poster && npm run render:mobile && npm run render:mobile-web && npm run render:mobile-webm && npm run render:mobile-poster
